providerDefault: on by default on Opus 5 and Sonnet 5; off on Opus 4.8, 4.7, 4.6 and Sonnet 4.6 until requested
summary: Selects Claude's reasoning mode. Adaptive thinking lets the model decide whether and how deeply to reason, while newer models may reason by default even when this field is omitted. It is kept internal because the legal/default behavior differs by model and manual token-budget thinking is deprecated or rejected on the current lineup.
combines: Fable 5 always uses adaptive thinking; Opus 5 and Sonnet 5 enable it by default.
Opus 4.8, Opus 4.7, Opus 4.6 and Sonnet 4.6 require thinking: {type: adaptive} to enable reasoning, so Lixpi supplies it internally.
Manual thinking with budget_tokens is deprecated on the 4.6 models and rejected on Claude 4.7 and later.
Effort remains the user-facing depth/cost control.
note: Provider/model-managed. Lixpi sends adaptive thinking only for reviewed legacy models where it is not enabled by default; it does not expose an on/off switch.
